skills.name: formal-spec
skills.description: Use when writing formal specifications in TLA+ to verify system properties, defining state variables, configuring TLC model checker, and documenting assumptions and limitations. Covers safety and liveness properties for protocols and concurrent systems. Do not use for security claim enumeration without specification intent (use invariant-analysis).
skills.description_zh: 编写 TLA+ 形式规格，定义状态变量、配置 TLC 模型检查器，验证协议或并发系统的安全性与活性，并记录假设和限制。

skills.name: invariant-analysis
skills.description: Use when enumerating security claims from a design, formalizing them as invariants, checking for hidden assumptions, and assessing verification feasibility. Covers safety invariants, temporal properties, and verification tool recommendations. Do not use for writing TLA+ specifications directly (use formal-spec) or implementation-level security review.
skills.description_zh: 从设计中提取安全声明并形式化为不变量，检查隐含假设、时序性质和验证可行性，建议验证工具。

skills.name: competitive-analysis
skills.description: Use when designing features that exist in competing products or analyzing prior art in the market. Covers feature mapping, UX evaluation, technical trade-off assessment, and differentiation opportunity identification. Do not use for evaluating individual libraries (use library-evaluation) or assessing technology maturity (use technology-radar).
headings: Step 1: Identify Competing Products or Prior Art
Step 3: Evaluate UX and Interaction Approaches
Step 5: Identify Gaps and Differentiation Opportunities
skills.description_zh: 分析竞争产品中的已有功能及市场先例，比较功能、UX 与技术取舍，并寻找差异化机会。

skills.name: enterprise-search-strategy
skills.description: Use when the council needs to surface organizational knowledge buried across multiple internal sources (wikis, design docs, ADRs, past tickets, postmortems, chat archives, code repos). Plans where to look, what to cross-reference, and how to synthesize findings into evidence the council can act on. Do not use for external market research (use competitive-analysis), library evaluation (use library-evaluation), or technology trend assessment (use technology-radar).
headings: Step 5: Package Evidence for the Council
skills.description_zh: 跨内部 Wiki、设计文档、ADR、工单、复盘、聊天和代码库查找组织知识，规划检索与交叉核对，并综合为可行动证据。

skills.name: library-evaluation
skills.description: Use when adding new packages, choosing between dependency alternatives, or auditing existing libraries. Covers popularity metrics, maintenance health, bundle impact, API quality, and license compatibility with weighted scoring. Do not use for evaluating frameworks or platforms (use technology-radar) or comparing competing products (use competitive-analysis).
headings: Step 5: Review API Quality and Developer Experience
skills.description_zh: 对新依赖、候选库或已有库进行加权评估，检查普及度、维护状况、包体积、API 质量及许可证兼容性。

skills.name: technology-radar
skills.description: Use when evaluating frameworks, tools, or platforms for adoption, migration, or stack decisions. Covers maturity assessment, ecosystem health, team readiness, migration cost, and long-term viability with radar quadrant placement. Do not use for comparing individual libraries (use library-evaluation) or analyzing competing products (use competitive-analysis).
headings: Step 4: Check Team Familiarity and Learning Curve
Step 5: Estimate Migration Cost from Current Stack
Step 7: Evaluate Alignment with Project Requirements
skills.description_zh: 评估框架、工具或平台的采用及迁移，比较成熟度、生态、团队准备、迁移成本与长期可用性，并定位技术雷达象限。

skills.name: embedded-architecture
skills.description: Use when designing firmware architecture for embedded or IoT devices. Covers RTOS selection, memory layout, power state machine, task decomposition, and watchdog recovery design. Do not use for wireless protocol selection (use protocol-design) or fleet-scale device management (use fleet-management).
skills.description_zh: 设计嵌入式或 IoT 固件架构，选择 RTOS、规划内存、电源状态机、任务拆分和看门狗恢复。

skills.name: fleet-management
skills.description: Use when designing fleet management infrastructure for IoT device fleets. Covers device provisioning, OTA firmware update strategy, telemetry pipeline design, fleet monitoring, remote management, and scaling projections. Do not use for firmware architecture (use embedded-architecture) or wireless protocol selection (use protocol-design).
skills.description_zh: 设计 IoT 设备群管理，涵盖开通、OTA 固件更新、遥测、监控、远程管理及规模预测。

skills.name: protocol-design
skills.description: Use when selecting and designing communication protocol stacks for IoT or embedded systems. Covers physical layer selection, transport and application protocols, security layers, message format design, and error resilience. Do not use for firmware architecture (use embedded-architecture) or fleet-scale operations (use fleet-management).
headings: Step 6: Design Error Handling and Resilience
skills.description_zh: 选择和设计 IoT 或嵌入式通信协议栈，明确物理层、传输与应用协议、安全层、消息格式及错误恢复能力。

skills.name: edge-case-enumeration
skills.description: Use when systematically discovering edge cases for proposed features using structured enumeration techniques. Covers input boundary analysis, state combinations, concurrency scenarios, temporal edge cases, and permission edge cases. Do not use for security threat analysis (use threat-model) or infrastructure failure discovery (use failure-mode-analysis).
skills.description_zh: 系统枚举功能边界情况，分析输入边界、状态组合、并发、时间和权限场景。

skills.name: failure-mode-analysis
skills.description: Use when systematically identifying failure scenarios for proposed features and infrastructure changes. Covers component enumeration, failure mode discovery, cascade analysis, mitigation design, monitoring signals, and rollback planning. Do not use for security threat modeling (use threat-model) or input boundary testing (use edge-case-enumeration).
headings: Step 2: Enumerate Failure Modes Per Component
skills.description_zh: 系统识别功能及基础设施变更的失败场景，枚举组件、分析故障级联，设计缓解、监控信号和回滚。

skills.name: threat-model
skills.description: Use when applying STRIDE threat modeling to identify security risks in proposed features. Covers trust boundary mapping, data flow analysis, threat rating, mitigation proposals, and residual risk documentation. Do not use for failure scenario discovery (use failure-mode-analysis) or boundary value testing (use edge-case-enumeration).
headings: Step 3: Apply STRIDE Per Data Flow
skills.description_zh: 应用 STRIDE 进行威胁建模，映射信任边界与数据流，评定风险、提出缓解措施并记录剩余风险。

skills.name: analytics-design
skills.description: Use when planning measurement strategy for a feature or product area. Covers metrics hierarchy design, event taxonomy, funnel instrumentation, A/B test framework, and data pipeline planning. Do not use for feature prioritization scoring (use impact-estimation) or MVP scope definition (use mvp-scoping).
headings: Step 7: Plan Data Pipeline and Storage
skills.description_zh: 规划功能或产品的衡量策略，设计指标层级、事件分类、漏斗埋点、A/B 测试框架及数据流水线。

skills.name: impact-estimation
skills.description: Use when comparing multiple features or initiatives to determine prioritization order. Covers RICE scoring with quantified reach, impact, confidence, and effort dimensions, tier ranking, and success metric definition. Do not use for MVP scope definition (use mvp-scoping) or analytics instrumentation planning (use analytics-design).
headings: Step 2: Score Each Feature on All 4 Dimensions
Step 4: Rank Features by RICE Score
Step 5: Identify Quick Wins vs Strategic Bets
Step 6: Define Success Metrics and KPIs
skills.description_zh: 以量化覆盖、影响、信心和工作量进行 RICE 评分，比较功能或项目优先级，并定义成功指标。

skills.name: mvp-scoping
skills.description: Use when defining minimum viable scope for a product or feature launch. Covers MoSCoW prioritization, value-effort matrix analysis, MVP cut-line definition, and phased roadmap planning. Do not use for quantified feature comparison (use impact-estimation) or measurement instrumentation (use analytics-design).
headings: Step 3: Estimate Effort for Each Feature
Step 4: Estimate Value/Impact for Each Feature
Step 6: Define the MVP Cut Line
skills.description_zh: 界定产品或功能发布的最小可行范围，使用 MoSCoW 和价值工作量矩阵确定 MVP 截止线及分阶段路线图。

skills.name: caching-strategy
skills.description: Use when designing or auditing a caching architecture. Covers multi-layer cache hierarchy, key schema, TTL policies, invalidation flows, and warming strategies. Do not use for runtime performance profiling (use performance-audit) or capacity planning (use load-modeling).
headings: Step 1: Identify Cacheable Resources and Access Patterns
Step 4: Specify TTL Policies per Resource Type
Step 7: Specify Cache Warming Strategy for Cold Starts
skills.description_zh: 设计或审核缓存架构，明确多层缓存、键格式、TTL、失效流程及预热策略。

skills.name: load-modeling
skills.description: Use when planning capacity or projecting infrastructure needs under growth. Covers traffic modeling, endpoint heat maps, scaling triggers, benchmark design, and cost-at-scale estimates. Do not use for runtime bottleneck profiling (use performance-audit) or cache architecture design (use caching-strategy).
headings: Step 2: Model Request Distribution Across Endpoints
Step 3: Identify Resource Bottlenecks at Scale
Step 4: Define Horizontal and Vertical Scaling Triggers
Step 5: Design Benchmark Suite for Critical Paths
Step 6: Plan Capacity Thresholds and Alerts
skills.description_zh: 规划容量和增长后的基础设施需求，建立流量模型、接口热点图、扩容触发条件、基准测试及规模成本估算。

skills.name: performance-audit
skills.description: Use when profiling application performance or diagnosing slow page loads. Covers full-stack bottleneck identification including Core Web Vitals, bundle analysis, database queries, and network waterfall. Do not use for cache architecture design (use caching-strategy) or capacity planning (use load-modeling).
headings: Step 3: Analyze Bundle Size and Code Splitting
Step 6: Assess Core Web Vitals Scores
skills.description_zh: 分析应用性能或页面加载缓慢，定位 Core Web Vitals、包体积、数据库查询和网络请求瀑布中的全栈瓶颈。

skills.name: hw-sw-boundary
skills.description: Use when reviewing the hardware/software security interface to verify hardware security feature enablement, IOMMU/SMMU DMA protection configuration, and HW/SW trust model coherence. Covers boot chain verification, memory protection, and control flow integrity features. Do not use for kernel configuration audit (use kernel-hardening) or isolation boundary analysis (use isolation-review).
headings: Step 2: Verify Kernel Enables HW Features
skills.description_zh: 审核软硬件安全接口，检查硬件安全特性、IOMMU/SMMU 的 DMA 防护、启动链、内存保护及控制流完整性。

skills.name: isolation-review
skills.description: Use when mapping isolation boundaries, enumerating crossing points, verifying enforcement mechanisms, and testing for bypass paths across trust domains. Covers containers, VMs, enclaves, namespaces, seccomp, and network segmentation. Do not use for kernel configuration audit (use kernel-hardening) or HW/SW security interface review (use hw-sw-boundary).
skills.description_zh: 映射跨信任域的隔离边界和穿越点，验证执行机制及绕过路径，涵盖容器、虚拟机、飞地、命名空间、seccomp 和网络隔离。

skills.name: kernel-hardening
skills.description: Use when auditing kernel security configuration for memory protection, syscall surface reduction, control flow integrity, and integrity mechanisms against local and remote attack vectors. Covers CIS/KSPP benchmarks, KASLR, SMAP/SMEP, seccomp, and secure boot chain. Do not use for isolation boundary analysis (use isolation-review) or HW/SW interface review (use hw-sw-boundary).
skills.description_zh: 按 CIS/KSPP 等基准审核内核安全配置，检查内存保护、系统调用面、控制流与完整性机制、KASLR、SMAP/SMEP、seccomp 和安全启动链。

description: Convene 20 agentic specialists on your hardest engineering problems. Distinct perspectives, unified design, actionable plans, every decision tracked. Ships sibling councils for finance, people, and revenue under their own slash commands.
